metadata.title: feat: Phase 3 JS test coverage — filters, UI, HTML, forms (512 tests)
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Add 4 new Vitest test files covering ~25 additional admin.js functions (106 new tests, 406 → 512 total)
- Push admin.js statement coverage from 7.69% to 11.71% (+4.02%) and function coverage from 11.53% to 17.02% (+5.49%)
- Overall JS statement coverage: 9.25% → 13.2%

### New test files

| File | Tests | Functions covered |
|------|------:|-------------------|
| `admin-filters.test.js` | 32 | `filterServerTable`, `filterToolsTable`, `filterResourcesTable`, `filterPromptsTable`, `filterA2AAgentsTable`, `filterGatewaysTable`, `addTagToFilter`, `filterEntitiesByTags`, `clearTagFilter` |
| `admin-ui.test.js` | 32 | `showErrorMessage`, `showSuccessMessage`, `showNotification`, `validatePasswordRequirements`, `validatePasswordMatch`, `updateSelectionCount`, `selectAllItems`, `selectNoneItems`, `dedupeSelectorItems`, `copyToClipboard` |
| `admin-html.test.js` | 25 | `createSystemSummaryCard`, `createKPISection`, `createPerformanceCard`, `createRecentActivitySection`, `createMetricsCard` |
| `admin-forms.test.js` | 17 | `generateSchema`, `updateRequestTypeOptions`, `updateEditToolRequestTypes`, `cleanUpUrlParamsForTab` |

### Coverage delta

| Metric | Before | After | Delta |
|--------|-------:|------:|------:|
| admin.js stmts | 7.69% | 11.71% | +4.02% |
| admin.js branch | 6.12% | 8.81% | +2.69% |
| admin.js funcs | 11.53% | 17.02% | +5.49% |
| Overall stmts | 9.25% | 13.2% | +3.95% |
| Total tests | 406 | 512 | +106 |

### Notes

- `filterEntitiesByTags` non-empty-filter tests are skipped because admin.js uses CSS comments (`/* ... */`) inside a `querySelectorAll` selector, which JSDOM's nwsapi parser cannot handle. The empty-filter path is covered.

## Test plan

- [x] `npx vitest run` — 512 tests pass
- [x] `npx vitest run --coverage` — coverage numbers verified

commits.message:
feat: add JS tests for DOM, async, FlameGraph, and GanttChart (406 tests)

Add 4 new test files covering DOM-dependent functions, async/fetch
utilities, and visualization classes:
- admin-dom.test.js: 56 tests for DOM manipulation functions
- admin-async.test.js: 25 tests for fetch/auth functions
- flame-graph.test.js: 24 tests (98% statement coverage)
- gantt-chart.test.js: 30 tests (87% statement coverage)

Total: 406 tests across 11 files. Overall coverage: 9.25% statements,
14.89% functions. flame-graph.js and gantt-chart.js raised from 0%.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
